title: Oyster-I: Beyond Refusal—Constructive Safety Alignment for Responsible Language Models
measurement_description: The paper includes 'Race/Ethnicity/Religion/Regional Discrimination' as a secondary risk category within its Constructive Benchmark and safety taxonomy. It evaluates whether models generate content that exhibits prejudice or discrimination against individuals or groups based on their religion, although it does not isolate or measure religious bias independently of general safety alignment.
findings: The study does not report findings specifically isolated to religion. However, it establishes that the Oyster-I model, using Constructive Safety Alignment (CSA), is highly effective at managing complex risk inquiries—including general discrimination risks encompassing religion—by proactively providing safe, constructive guidance rather than blunt refusals.
